svg.aria-label: 7 steered consoles' distance from center, 15 to 20 October
svg.title: 7 steered consoles' distance from center, 15 to 20 October
svg.desc: A precise reading at each clock check of how far each of 7 Davis Envoys at one site stood from the center of its daily drift, 285 readings from 15 to 20 October, one row a console. None is more than 0.19 seconds from center; the band the driver keeps each night's landing in is 0.19 seconds either side of center. A marker above a row shows a midnight at which that console made a new jump. No clock was set.
svg.text: Seven Envoys, steered: how far each clock is from center, seconds
dots: a precise reading at each clock check (285, none more than 0.19 s off); shaded: the band, give or take 0.19 s
▼ a new jump made at that midnight; dotted lines are midnight
